scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,orange "npm run dev --workspace client" "npm run dev --workspace server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');for(const path of ['dist','dist-server','tsconfig.tsbuildinfo'])fs.rmSync(path,{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm run clean --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace client && npm run typecheck --workspace server
